content.rendered: The start of school is just around the corner, and we are so excited to welcome our students and families back to our schools! For important information to help you and your family navigate the start of the school year, please see our special “Back-to-School” edition of the district newsletter at the following link: https://www.smore.com/26bas. Additionally, please don’t hesitate to reach out with any questions to your school office, or our District Office at 503-825-5000. Please watch for additional emails from your child’s school as we get closer to the first day of school.
